description: This file is a script for managing documentation versions in a project, including adding and removing versions, fixing import paths, and updating configuration files. It interacts with the filesystem, executes shell commands, and processes JSON configuration data.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Reads and parses the JSON configuration file for version management.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Serializes and writes the updated configuration object back to the JSON file.

methods.name: fixVersionedImports
methods.description: Adjusts import paths in specific documentation files for a given version.

methods.name: addVersion
methods.description: Creates a new documentation version, updates configuration, and fixes import paths if needed.

methods.name: removeVersion
methods.description: Removes a documentation version, deletes related files, and updates configuration.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.
